entities.summary: Vojdan Stojanovski is a Macedonian professional basketball player who currently plays for MZT Skopje of the Macedonian League. He is in height and plays at the shooting guard position. He is the twin brother of Damjan Stojanovski and the younger brother of former basketball player Ognen Stojanovski.
